## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** Patient Appointment Management

**Test Suite Description:** This suite tests the functionalities of the Patient Appointment Management system.

**Test Suite Scope:**
- Querying patient details
- Creating patient appointments
- Providing consultations
- Dispensing medicines
- Ordering lab tests
- Generating lab reports

**Test Suite Preconditions:**
- The system is running.
- The user is logged in.

**Test Suite Postconditions:**
- The system state is consistent.

**Test Cases:**

**TC-001:** Querying Patient Details
- **Requirement ID:** VCDPA03
- **Test Case Type:** Positive
- **Test Case Description:** Verify that the patient details are displayed correctly when a valid patient ID is entered.
- **Test Case Steps:**
    - Enter a valid patient ID.
    - Verify that the patient details are displayed.
- **Expected Result:** The patient details are displayed correctly.

**TC-002:** Creating Patient Appointment
- **Requirement ID:** VCDPA04
- **Test Case Type:** Positive
- **Test Case Description:** Verify that a new appointment is created when the user submits the appointment form.
- **Test Case Steps:**
    - Enter the patient ID.
    - Select the appointment date and time.
    - Enter the specialty, symptoms, and consultation request.
    - Click the submit button.
- **Expected Result:** A new appointment is created in the Patient Appointment file.

**TC-003:** Providing Consultation
- **Requirement ID:** VCDDR01
- **Test Case Type:** Positive
- **Test Case Description:** Verify that the doctor can see all the consultation requests.
- **Test Case Steps:**
    - Log in as a doctor.
    - Verify that the consultation requests are displayed.
- **Expected Result:** The doctor can see all the consultation requests.

**TC-004:** Prescribing Medicines
- **Requirement ID:** VCDDR02
- **Test Case Type:** Positive
- **Test Case Description:** Verify that the doctor can prescribe medicines for a patient.
- **Test Case Steps:**
    - Select a consultation request.
    - Enter the diagnosis.
    - Enter the prescribed medicines.
    - Click the submit button.
- **Expected Result:** The prescription is created and the flag is marked in the Patient Appointment file.

**TC-005:** Dispensing Medicines
- **Requirement ID:** VCDCM01
- **Test Case Type:** Positive
- **Test Case Description:** Verify that the chemist can dispense medicines for a patient.
- **Test Case Steps:**
    - Log in as a chemist.
    - Select a prescription.
    - Verify that the medicines are dispensed.
    - Mark the flag in the prescription.
- **Expected Result:** The medicines are dispensed and the flag is marked in the prescription.

**TC-006:** Ordering Lab Tests
- **Requirement ID:** VCDLB01
- **Test Case Type:** Positive
- **Test Case Description:** Verify that the lab can order lab tests for a patient.
- **Test Case Steps:**
    - Log in as a lab technician.
    - Select a prescription.
    - Enter the lab tests to be done.
    - Click the submit button.
- **Expected Result:** The lab tests are ordered and the flag is marked in the prescription.

**TC-007:** Generating Lab Report
- **Requirement ID:** VCDLB02
- **Test Case Type:** Positive
- **Test Case Description:** Verify that the lab can generate a lab report for a patient.
- **Test Case Steps:**
    - Log in as a lab technician.
    - Select a prescription.
    - Enter the lab report.
    - Click the submit button.
- **Expected Result:** The lab report is generated and the flag is marked in the prescription.
